BACKEND_SIGNER.reason: EcoFacet has no deployRequirements configData entry for the backend signer, so there is no declared value to compare against. Add one pointing at global.json .backendSigner.<ENVIRONMENT>, as AcrossV4SwapFacet, LayerSwapFacet, NEARIntentsFacet and SymbiosisFacet already do, and reclassify as config.

pauserWallet.reason: EmergencyPauseFacet has no deployRequirements entry at all, so no configData key names the pauser wallet. global.json .pauserWallet is the value the deploy script uses; adding that entry makes this config.

_emergencyPauseFacetAddress.rule: address(this) at construction, so it equals the deployment's own address.

LIFI_DIAMOND.reason: The deploy script reads the diamond from deployments/<network>.json .LiFiDiamond, not from config/. Layer 2 resolves config-sourced expectations through configData only, so a deployment-log address has no expression in this registry.

BENTO_BOX.rule: address(0). DeployLiFiDEXAggregator.s.sol passes the literal, as the upstream RouteProcessor4 deployment does; no config file carries a BentoBox address.

recoverGas.rule: The gas stipend DeployReceiverStargateV2.s.sol passes as a literal (100000). It is a gas budget, not an address, and no config file carries it.

IS_HUB.rule: block.chainid == ARBITRUM_CHAIN_ID at construction, so it is true on Arbitrum and false everywhere else.

CONVERTER.rule: _converter when it is non-zero, otherwise _wrappedToken — so it is config/tokenconverters.json .<NETWORK>.converterAddress on a network that has one, and the wrapped token's own address on one that does not.

USE_CONVERTER.rule: _converter != address(0), i.e. true exactly on networks whose tokenconverters.json entry names a converter.

SWAP_RATIO_MULTIPLIER.rule: 10 ** IERC20Metadata(_wrappedToken).decimals() when a converter is used, otherwise 1 ether. It is read from the wrapped token at construction, so no config file carries it.

BACKEND_SIGNER.reason: UnitFacet has no deployRequirements entry at all, so no configData key names the backend signer. config/unit.json .<ENVIRONMENT>.backendSigner is the value the deploy script uses — note the key order is environment first, unlike global.json's .backendSigner.<ENVIRONMENT> that the other backend-signer facets use. Adding that entry makes this config.
